affirmations: I deserve care, even on difficult days.
My feelings are worth listening to.
I can take one step at a time.
I do not have to have every answer today.
I am allowed to ask for support.
My pace is my own.
I can be learning and still be enough.
I deserve to be treated with respect.
I can make room for rest.
I am more than one hard moment.
I can choose what I am ready to share.
My boundaries matter.
I can reach out when I need connection.
I am allowed to change and grow.
I deserve spaces where I feel welcome.
I can take a pause without giving up.
My experiences are part of me, not all of me.
I can be kind to myself while I figure things out.
It is okay to seek help from someone qualified.
I belong in conversations about my wellbeing.
